p: midst whereof I dwell: There were three types of tents: of the Lord, of the Levites, and of the Israelites.
that men commit: Commit any fault willingly.
man have no kinsman to recompense: If he is dead to whom the wrong is done and also has no relatives.
holy things of the children of: Or, things offered to the Lord, as first fruits, etc.
go aside: By breaking the band of marriage, and playing the harlot.
oil upon it: Only in the sin offering, and so this offering of jealousy were neither oil nor incense offered.
remembrance: Or, making the sin known, and not purging it.
holy water in an earthen vessel: Which also is called the water of purification of sprinkling, read Nu 19:9.
curse: It was so called by the effect, because it declared the woman to be accursed, and turned to her destruction.
curse and an oath among thy: Both because she had committed so heinous a fault, and forswore herself in denying the same.
Amen: That is, may it be as you wished, as in Ps 41:13; De 27:15.
blot them out with the bitter: Shall wash the curses, which are written, into the water in the vessel.
altar: Where the incense was offered.
guiltless from iniquity: The man might accuse his wife on suspicion and not be reproved.
